description: The Advanced Technology Microwave Sounder (ATMS) on NOAA-20 (JPSS-1), a 22-channel cross-track microwave sounder (23.8-183.31 GHz). The curves are the 61 channel spectral response functions of NOAA STAR's 'NOAA-20 ATMS Spectral Response Function (SRF) Dataset' (1/22/2018): NASA/GSFC RF-frequency SRFs at +20 C for the primary (A) and redundant (B) local oscillators, converted from frequency to wavelength.
facility_description: The Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS) is NOAA's polar-orbiting series (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21, ...).

notes: Band names follow SVO's JPSS/ATMS-J1 IDs: A/B = primary/redundant LO; L/U = lower/upper sideband (ch12-15 sideband-balance sweeps, ch18-22 passbands); ch17A1/A2/B1 = sideband-balance runs. Channels 1-2 are direct-detect (no LO, a single curve). Per the zip's READMEs: ch3-9 and 16 were measured at the IF and converted to RF by GSFC; ch10-15 and 17 come from sideband-balance (RF) data; ch18-22 passbands were derived by GSFC from bandpass-characteristics data and have zero sideband imbalance. Response in dB converted to linear and scaled to peak 1; wavelength = c/nu. SVO's archived ATMS-J1 records have pivots 10 times larger than c/nu of these channels (pivot ratio exactly 0.100 for every band); the NJM curves use the correct conversion. DetectorType energy is assumed.
